policy: A recipe is LAUNCH_READY only when it carries zero open QA flags (duplicate/timing/quantity/high-risk-scaling) and has a complete Phase 2.4 dietary classification record. Everything else is HELD_FOR_KITCHEN_TEST -- excluded from the launch set, never guessed into it. No recipe in this baseline was DROPPED outright: the 0 exact-duplicate and 0 timing/quantity flags found in Phase 2 QA mean every held recipe is a real, distinct, plausibly-correct recipe that needs a scaling/kitchen-test pass, not a defective one.
